_about: Public-domain Franz Hunolt (1691-1746), Jesuit preacher at the cathedral of Trier, in English for the Word Hoard: Hunolt's Sermons, adapted to all the Sundays and holydays of the year, translated by the Rev. J. Allen (12 vols., New York: Benziger, 1886-1897): The Christian State of Life, The Bad Christian, The Penitent Christian, The Good Christian, The Christian's Last End and The Christian's Model, two volumes each. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 82 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
